Styling overview
How to set up CSS - exact imports for three paths: plain, Tailwind, and StyleX for your own code - plus the stylesheet
each Astryx package ships.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

pick-a-path          Pick a path - All three load the same prebuilt Astryx stylesheets, resolve to the same design
                     tokens, and support theming and dark mode. None of them compiles Astryx package source. You can mix
                     them in one app.
plain                Plain CSS - Done. Components work out of the box - style them with `className`, `xstyle`, or
                     `style`. Swap `theme-neutral` for any theme package (`npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme list`
                     shows what's available).
tailwind             Tailwind - The `@layer` declaration is critical - without it, component styles outrank Tailwind
                     utilities and `className` overrides stop working. The bridge (`tailwind-theme.css`) maps classes
                     like `text-primary`, `bg-surface`, and `rounded-lg` to...
stylex-own-code      StyleX for your own code - Only needed when you write your own StyleX (`stylex.create()`) or
                     swizzle a component (`npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 swizzle <Component>`), which copies its StyleX
                     source into your app. The plain path already supports `xstyle` overrides - this path is for your...
other-packages       Other Astryx packages - Every Astryx package whose components carry styles ships its own prebuilt
                     stylesheet. Import it after `astryx.css` for each package you use. All of them place their rules in
                     the same `astryx-base` layer, so your theme overrides win over...
what-each-file-does  What each import does
further-reading      Further reading - `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling` - xstyle, className, data-attribute
                     selectors, design tokens in code.

Read one section: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview <section>
Read everything:  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview --full
